test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 3rd December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Alive and kicking

options.text: Money earned in return for little work

solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. "Healthy and doing well."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let’s look at the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase: 
 
• The phrase 'Alive and kicking' means 'to continue to live or exist and be full of energy.' 
 
• *Example*:
 
 
• *Sneha said she'd seen John last week and he was **alive and kicking.***
 
 
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 1 'Healthy and doing well,' which exactly resembles the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase.

 

Correct meaning:__ *Healthy and doing well.*
